$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFEZ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Nancy - Malzéville

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for pilots members of Union Aeronautique Metropole Grand Nancy and pilots authorised by AD operator.
Warning: towing cables unrolled on the northern part of the runway in use (width 5 m).
Possible presence of sheeps near the RWY.
Non home-based ACFT shall proceed overhead AD at 3000 ft AAL before entering the traffic circuit.
Except for safety reasons, avoid overflight of the AD below 2500 ft AAL.
Taxiing: mark the stop before crossing the RWY.
Announce your intentions on A/A FREQ before rolling or taxiing again.
Gliders towing activity (NR 944): See AIP ENR 5.5 Gliders' aerobatics activity (NR 6154): See AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (NR 8055): See AIP ENR 5.5
AD réservé aux pilotes membres de l'Union Aéronautique Métropole Grand Nancy et aux pilotes autorisés par l'exploitant.
Attention : câbles de treuillage déroulés sur la partie nord de la piste en service (largeur 5 m).
Présence possible d'ovins à proximité des pistes.
Verticale AD à 3000 ft AAL pour tout avion non basé avant intégration dans le tour de piste.
Sauf pour des raisons de sécurité, éviter le survol de l'AD en dessous de 2500 ft AAL.
Roulage : marquer l'arrêt avant toute traversée de piste.
Annoncer vos intentions sur FREQ A/A avant de rouler ou de reprendre le roulage.
Activité de treuillage planeurs (N°944) : Voir AIP ENR 5.5 Activité voltige planeurs (N°6154) : Voir AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (N° 8055) : Voir AIP ENR 5.5
